notes.title: Bamboo Sticks Update
notes.notes:
Dear Students,  


Discipline in kung fu takes many forms. For centuries, masters have trained not only with their fists, but with the humble bamboo stick: a weapon of precision, reach, and flow. 🌿  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/43eec9475ab37adf81edf9a18818246ba94df2c3.png"]

Today, I’m proud to bring that tradition into *Crazy Kung Fu*. With the **Bamboo Sticks Update**, you can now take on most levels wielding dual sticks instead of your hands and bracers. A new challenge, a new rhythm, and a new way to test your skill.  

Whether you’re blocking lightning-fast strikes or landing your own combos, the bamboo sticks demand accuracy and speed. They offer power, but also responsibility: control is everything.  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/e8db60613960c82cf6822fff2e20bc7aef279432.png"]
What’s new:  
Bamboo Sticks Gameplay — Play most levels with bamboo sticks instead of hands or bracers, they are in the MODS section.  

New Challenges — Striking and blocking with sticks introduces fresh timing and spacing.  

Immersive Feel — Train like martial artists have for generations, with precision tools instead of fists.  



This is just the beginning, more training methods and features are coming. Thank you for your dedication and feedback; your practice inspires every update. 🙏  

Stay strong, stay focused, and may your strikes be true.

notes.title: 🏮Year of the Dragon Update!🏮
notes.notes:
🏮 Dear Students,

As the vibrant Year of the Tiger 🐯 gracefully bows out, we stand on the threshold of the majestic Year of the Dragon 🐉. It's a time of immense energy, unwavering courage, and boundless possibilities. In this spirit I invite you to deepen your practice, embrace fitness, and cultivate health like never before. 🙏

In celebration of the new year, I am honored to introduce a symbol of protection and strength: the Guardian  mask. This free cosmetic piece is not just an adornment but a testament to your dedication and progress. Wear it with pride as you navigate through challenges, embodying the guardian spirit that watches over you and your path to mastery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/ecaaa7f9ac99039c991b9fc3156cbb1d2a311696.jpg

Complementing the Guardian, the Crimson Bracers emerge as a beacon of passion and power. Crafted from the heart of the dragon's flame, these bracers are designed to inspire and propel you forward, adding a touch of elegance and fiercenes to your training. 👊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/91119e443012cc0f505e9a4c4c194dacafd701ce.png

As always, simply boot up the game and you'll be automatically gifted the mask and bracers!

This update also includes a few fixes, thanks to those who helped me track them down:

 Fixed issue where in some instances in Train Tier 3 stats would displaying many more mistakes than you had actually made. Sorry about that! (Thanks to Zorro and The_Raven_Child).
 Fixed a similar issue where in some instances stats would display more total appeared punches/blocks than had actually appeared during the level. Making it impossible to get 100%! 😱
 Removed the ankward ending to levels when the dummy arms are no longer interactable on the last few seconds as it cools down.
 Revised some logic in the multiplayer session list so that when a session is available/unavailable the list updates much faster.
 Various other quality of life improvements, small things but still important. ❤️


What's next: I'm working on private sessions so that you can sync up with friends more easily! 

I look forward to witnessing your achievements, celebrating your growth, and sharing this incredible journey with you. Here’s to a year filled with strength, health, and prosperity! 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340300/Crazy_Kung_Fu/

notes.title: Update 0.84 - Fight Mode
notes.notes:
Dear Students

I've been very excited to work on this update, which revises the way Fight Mode works. There are a few core things that have changed which will make using this Mode much more enjoyable and practical in your Kung Fu journey. 

For example there is now a selection of 3 space sizes for Fight Mode, as to be able to cover a variety of play space and allow you to chose what fits best for you. The dummy in Fight Mode is also now much more aware of your space and will not drive you outside of the space you have selected. 

Already with these two new functionalities you should see an improvement in your training, allowing you to fully utilise your play area and further improve your skills without worrying about your physical environment.

There's more updates too, so check out the full list here.

Updates and fixes:

 Fight Mode now has 3 play space size selections: 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4.
 Fight mode dummy AI will respect your play space boundaries and no longer drive you out of the area.
 New camera fade between all scenes and enviornments accross all platforms to solve certain issues with camera renders, recordings and MR devices.
 Fight Mode can now also be unlocked by getting a total acculumative score in Train Mode of 1,000,000 points, in addition to being unlocked by completing Train Tier 1.
 Updated all numbers to include commas, as to be more legible.
 Fixed sidequest achievements not appearing (Quest only)
 Fixed Fight Mode not unlocking after completing Train Tier 1 until restarting the game.


If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!

As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Update 0.82 - Wing Chun Training Game
notes.notes:
Dear Students

I hope you will appreciate this months update as much as I've enjoyed working on it. It's taken a lot of thought, and will most likely need some refining as we progress with our journey together. 

This update brings Wing Chun Dummy Training to VR. You will learn some basic shapes and forms whilst scoring to get to higher levels of training.

This new Training game is not only important in order for me to share Martial Arts with everyone through VR, but as a new medium (VR) it's particularly important to lay down some good foundations for what will be built in the future. And I believe that sharing, learning and respect, which are all part of the essence of Martial Arts, are good pillars for how we should use VR for years to come.

So this is my small input into what is, and will be, an incredible medium to be part of. And together we will help shape our digital futures into a place were we can not only learn, but grow together.

Updates and fixes:

 A new Wing Chun Dummy Training game has been added to the Study section. Use speed and accuracy to achieve the correct shapes as you progress through increasing levels of difficulty and knowledge.
 Update impact VFX and AFX. The visual/audio effects are now more distinct between blocking and punching, as well as much more interesting: they no longer block your view as they are semi-transparent, and their relative size and volume is based on how hard the impact is.
 Removed shrimp modifiers due to it not working with the new hand system. Will be added back in in a future update! (thanks to TheWarKitty)
 Reduced volume of plank punch sounds (thanks to LetoDK)
 Did some optimising and cleanup, game now takes ~15% less storage (you can now use this free space to store videos of your Kung Fu awesomness!)
 Fixed issue where Tier 3 arms some stay red/white (thanks to d20diceman)
 Fixed issue where Stats/score on scroll not updating after returning to Train tab from Fight tab. (thanks to DenHBR)
 Add minimum score for Fight Mode on scroll (thanks to DenHBR)
 Add highest score for Fight More on scroll (thanks to DenHBR)


If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!

As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Update 0.80 - Tutorial and accuracy!
notes.notes:
Dear Students

The theme of this update is "clearer instructions". That means that my main focus has been to help build a better understanding of how to play the game, the best way to get good scores and develop stronger knowledge of the overall game mechanics as a player.

One fo the core parts of this update is a entirely new and much more detailed tutorial. There have also been quite a few other updates, especially around accuracy and scoring. Here's the full list:

Updates and fixes:

 New tutorial! It now has much more detail and goes through each movement individually to make sure that everyone has time to learn from it and rehearse.
 "Timing" has now become "Accuracy". Accuracy is calculated based on when you make contact with your target. There is an optimal time to do so. See next point!
 Ghost outline in Train Tiers 1 and 2 to show when to get the best accuracy.
 Option in Extras settings to remove ghost outline and gain a bonus multiplier.
 Highlight on dummy arm after punch/block to show if it was accurate or not. White for accurate, red for innacurate.
 Updated combos mechanics: Combo multiplier now only increases when your accuracy is good. The stack won't decrease if your accuracy is bad, but it still will if you do mistakes.
 Readjusted all score thresholds to suit the new combo and accuracy system. (scores have been reset on leaderboards for Train Tier 1 and 2, time to get back to the top!).
 Fight Tier 3 complete achievement (Honour) now unlocks properly! Go get it!
 Reduced dummy arm speed of Train Tier 1 for less harsh onboarding of new players.
 Train Tier 2 dummy movement is now more fluid.
 Fixed text overlap in some areas.


I hope this update is useful for all of you. If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!

As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Update 0.50 - Fight Mode
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! It's been a tough 2020 for everyone and I hope that I can help in some way to make 2021 better. Starting with a big update with a new game mode. 

I've really excited about this one, I've worked on it for a while. I've always wanted to make the dummy more active. In this new mode, Fight, you are against a similar dummy to Train mode but now it follows you, moves forwards, backwards, rotates full 360 and generally is more aggressive. 

In order to get scores you still need to strike the pads, block the poles and dodge the blades as in Train, but you'll also need to hit the pads that appear on the body of the dummy. These pads give you the highest points, and they can appear on any side of the dummy. So you will need to move around it, left and right, to get the pads when they appear. 

This mode is really to start bringing footwork to the experience. In Train we focus mainly on the upper body, now I want you to focus on your lower body too.

What's new:

 New Fight mode! In this mode you fight against a more active/reactive dummy. Currently this mode has 1 Tier (5 Levels). Once I've refined this mode enough I will add Tier 2, and then 3. Tier 1 Fight is only available once you have completed Tier 1 Train.
 Extended feedback after a Train mode level based on how you did. When completing a level, you will find a new board to your right with the detailed feedback.


New look:

 Menu scroll has now be redesigned to include Fight mode.
 Kung Fu mode is now called Train mode, to avoid confusion and make sense of the full journey. It now goes: Train, Fight, Focus, Study.
 Menu tabs have also been redesigned to be more practical when switching between sections.
 Study mode dummy and figurine are now to your right, and the menu scroll is back in the middle.
 Fight mode has it's own soundtrack! You can still disable music in the Extras setting, and play your own music externally while you train.


Updates and fixes:

 Train global leaderboard now has the top 15 players (previously top 10).
 In Fight mode score points are displayed on impact. This will allow you to briefly see the scores you are getting with each strike/block. If this feature gets a good response I can add it to Train mode too.
 Fight mode also has new grades, one for amount of body pad hits and the other for amount of lateral movement. Moving around the dummy is essential to this new mode. 
 Correct punch plank is now displayed when returning to menu after Focus.


What's next:

 Further refinement of Fight mode. Then onto including Fight mode Tier 2.
 Fight mode Tier 2 to have new dummy arms (surprise!).
 Adding a global leaderboard to Fight mode (once scoring has been refined).
 New environment.
 New soundtracks.


Thanks for the all support! Let's stay focused and train hard in 2021 together!

Arnaud

It's time to connect a bit more between ourselves, and earn your place on the board!

What's new:

There's now a global leaderboard in the game! So you can see how everyone else is getting on. And get a bit competitive maybe. Let's see!
 Score is added automatically and current logged in username is used.



This is the first version of the board. Let me know any feedback or suggestions. It will most likely change over time as I figure things out!

notes.title: Update 0.42 - Wing Chun Dummy!
notes.notes:
I've wanted to do this for a while, a virtual Wing Chun dummy. Just for you!

What's new:

 Study menu now includes a Wing Chun dummy!
 Import your own study pages to revise shapes without removing your headset. 


New look:

 Rearranged menu area, with environment spheres on the left and menu scroll on the right.
 Punch plank to start is now centre!


Updates and fixes:

 Fixed grade percentage text overlap when you get 100%
 Continued improvements on certain textures


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback! This game wouldn't be the same without your help.

notes.title: Update 0.40 - Tier 3
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New dummy arm! The new punch pad is now the 4th dummy arm, you can pummel away at it as long as you can!
 Tier 3! In this new Tier you will learn the importance of situational awarness. 
 New scoring system. There have been some big changes on how scores are calculated, so it's advised to reset the game from the Extras menu to make sure it all works well for you.


New look:

 Updated certain textures as part of a long term plan to refresh the quality of the assets
 Tier 3 double arm dummy. It's intense, and will keep you on your feet.
 New scroll level layout, to accomodate for Tier 3.


Updates and fixes:

 Grading board now has clearer info on what percentage gives you what extra score. 
 Scoring overall has changed a lot to work better across multiple platforms. Now the scoring system is identical and calculated the same for all devices.
 Lowest dummy arm now includes a short blade arm.
 Reset accuracy rings at the end of the level.
 Fixed issue where you could no longer grab an environment sphere after having grabbed it once.


What's next:

 New environment. 
 New training tool.
 


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback! This game wouldn't be the same without your help.

notes.title: Update 0.34 - New game mode: Focus.
notes.notes:
Really exited about this update! Hope you all enjoy it too. 

What's new:

 Focus Mode! In this mode you can build your own level.
 Focus Mode is accessible through the scroll menu item.


New look:

 Menu now has 4 tabs: Train (previously "Menu"), Focus, Study and Extra. In hopes that these tabs add claririty to what each section is for during your martial arts journey.
 Updated the size of the arm braces slightly to match more average arm sizes.
 Removed "punch plank to start" sign when in study mode to avoid confusion.
 Increased quality of certain textures! More to come.


Updates and fixes:

 Updated the grab mechanic further as to remove instances when it would break for some students.
 Updated the point mechanic to select on the scroll: you no longer need to pull the triggers and create a pointing motion. Simply touch the boxes with your index finger however you like!
 Fixed issue when you would untick the Padwork Extra but it would remain on the main board as selected.


What's next:

 Working on a new environment as the next update, outdoors! Then after that I hope to make more progress on Tier 3 release.
 More detailed and accurate feedback on punches/blocks timing and accuracy.


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback! This game wouldn't be the same without your help.

There will be more udpates to this game mode as I get feedback and requirements for customisations. My goal here is to allow you to focus on what you want to train on when you want to train. Giving you more control on your road to mastering kung-fu.

notes.title: Update 0.33 - New Extra mode: padwork!
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New Extra mode: Padwork! In this mode a pad will appear in front of you while you train against the dummy. When the pad appears, hit it. You need to react fast as it will disapear, and you will lose your combo.


Updates and fixes:

 Combo audio effect increases pitch each time. So it's easier to know you are making progress with the combos.
Updated level 1 and 2 unlock score threshold.


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback. I will be pushing regular updates over the coming weeks/months as we work together to make this a good training environment!

notes.title: Update 0.32 - Environment menu
notes.notes:
What's new:

 Environment selection! The environments no longer cycle through with each level. You still unlock them as you progress, then you can select them as you go.
 

New look:

 Environment selection menu will be on your right, in the form of orbs. Grab an orb and pull it to your head to transition to your favourite spot to train!


Updates and fixes:

 Continued updates on the scoring system to match the new combo/physics.
 Fixed issue where players could no longer grab the shrimp.

notes.title: Update 0.31 - Moving dummy and Tier system.
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New Tier 2! In this new tier you get to train against a moving dummy. The arm spins can be deceiving as the dummy rotates, so watch out as it tries to flank you left and right.
 The scoring system has also been updated entirely, as it's linked to the physics that has been updated. The points needed to unlock each level have changed to match that.


New look:

 Added floor graphic for Tier 2 for the moving dummy, though it will be replaced with a more interesting graphic soon as well.
 Updated scroll graphics and layout to fit the tier system.


Updates and fixes:

 Fixed issue where if players would pull the grip trigger over a button, the hand would no longer be able to select menu items.
 Combo scoring is now fixed, so scores will be higher throughout the game. Combos are x2, x3 and x4 scoring points. 
 Patched some snow clipping issues in the first dojo environment.
 Moved the Stop panel for the Infinite mode more behind the player on the right.
 


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback. I will be pushing regular updates over the coming weeks/months as we work together to make this a good training environment!

notes.title: Update 0.30 - Infinite game mode and more realistic physics.
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New Extra mode: Infinite! Now you can play any level for as long as you like! Score is displayed to you but not added to the leaderboard when using this Extra.


New look:

 Sifu now has somewhere to stand in each level!
 Updated scroll graphics and layout.
 Included more information for each Extra mode.
 Updated various in-game graphics.
 New intro logo animation.


Updates and fixes:

 Updated the way the dummy reacts to contact: Hitting or blocking at different intensities is now more noticeable.
 Continued improvemens in contact physics/detection.
 Fixed issue where in some cases the wrong controller would vibrate when punching and blocking.
 Fixed issue when playing at very high speed blocks wouldn't register.
 


Thank you to the current players who have been providing me feedback. I will be pushing regular updates over the coming weeks as we work together to make this a good training environment!
